HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • To lead mortgage sales team in people management, sales performance management, training and coaching, and operational risk control, so as to maximize the productivity of the team and contribute to the achievement of business strategy with high quality sales and service standard.
  • To lead the team to achieve the HML and Customer Acquisition requirement and minimize the risk.
  • The role also needs to closely monitor the sales and services quality provided by team members so as to ensure the sales/service process is strictly followed and the delivery of a consistently excellent customer experience.
  • To ensures fair outcomes for customers are delivered in all situations.
  • To manage, lead and motivate a team of highly mobile sales staff, and to lead a mobile sales team to focus on activities to expand HSBC’s new to wealth acquisition.
  • Role success will be achieved by focusing on striving to develop new relationships outside HSBC that will deliver sustainable growth and profitability.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education
  • Proven ability in mortgage sales
  • Current product/market knowledge
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Managerial experience
  • At least 5 years’ experience in supervisory role of sales function
  • Excellent interpersonal, leadership and motivation skills
  • Strong sales and organization ability and problem solving skills
  • Result driven and able to work under pressure
  • Good spoken and written English and Mandarin

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued By HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

 Business: Equities & X Asset Fin Tech

Job ID: 58966

Principal Responsibilities

  • Work with the product owner and Back Office Dev Lead to ensure that development work on GCP platform is well communicated, managed and delivered on time and with quality.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Proficient Java programming skills and GCP working experience.
  • Extensive experience designing, implementing, and optimizing ETL workflows using BigQuery.
  • Hands-on experiences on GCP auto build and deployment pipelines and autorelease processes.
  • Deep understanding of data warehousing principles and practices.
  • Experience with SQL query optimization and performance tuning in BigQuery
  • Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and the ability to leverage GCP services for data processing and analysis
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex data issues.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, IT architect, and business stakeholders. Fluent oral and written English is required.

Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People & Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriting Staffers manage a team of UW analysts as well as a portfolio of relationships across an Approved Elsewhere / GSG Corporates vertical, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk. This role reports to the Subcluster Head for the vertical.

Key Responsibilities:

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting,

including, but not limited to:

  • Lead execution of credit approvals, prepares and leads discussions with Risk and escalation within 1LOD; underwriting and monitoring of a portfolio of corporate clients, from early origination discussions to the development of credit approval memos and senior approval forums
  • Undertake comprehensive review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources (UW analysts)
  • Provide Underwriting sign-off and recommendation for transactions requiring senior approval
  • Has industry expertise and ability to discuss relevant macro and micro issues within coverage portfolio
  • Partner with Front Office on structuring new transactions and negotiating legal documentation − Build strong working relationships with key partners in Banking, Risk and with key regulators, audit/control functions
  • Lead credit conversation with both internal and external auditors related to coverage
  • Manage direct reports, tracks workload and helps to find staffing solutions to bottlenecks and urgent deliverables in cooperation with Underwriters
  • Lead the recruiting and onboarding processes where required
  • Cultivate and guide analysts, fostering team strengths and address developmental areas

Risk Management Experience:

  • Independently monitoring a portfolio of clients including (i) overseeing the timely and accurate production of credit approval memos and transactions and (ii) ability to clearly articulate recommendation to risk on credit reviews in both written and verbal communication
  • Superior risk assessment skills, including problem recognition, defining, and structuring of solutions to credit related issues; strong technical skills
  • Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards
  • Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures
  • Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues
  • Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations

Client Relationships / Business Partnership:

  • Strong understanding of capital markets products and complex financing and product structures
  • Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
  • Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments geographies and other risk functions
  • Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships
  • Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions
  • Proven ability to effectively engage with regulators and internal control functions including Internal Audit and Fundamental Credit Risk as well as with external audit
  • Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity
  • Ability to see the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment
  • Can make decisions under pressure and short timeline
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills.
  • Excellent presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies
  • Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

  • Understand business case, challenge benefit quantification, and do reality check.

  • Practical working knowledge of agile
  • Business Commerciality
  • Business Analysis and Design
  • Resource and Team Management and Leadership
  • Problem solving and Critical Thinking

  • Understanding of financial aspects of programmes

  • Strong analytical mindset with solid problem-solving skills and ability to analyses complex data, identify core issues and investigate, evaluate and conclude with solution recommendations

  • Share knowledge and good practice, work collaboratively with different parties to create a productive, diverse and supportive working environment

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective.
  • Coach teams on Agile/Scrum principles and continuously improve team maturity and delivery effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business processes, pain points and strategic priorities.
  • Conduct analysis and documentation of business requirements, user journeys and system/process impacts.
  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.
  • Partner with Product Owner and delivery teams to prioritize backlog items based on business value and dependencies.
  • Identify delivery risks, impediments and blockers; drive timely resolution and escalation where required.
  • Support UAT planning, test scenario definition and quality assurance alignment with business expectations.
  • Track and report sprint and release metrics (velocity, burn-down, cycle time, delivery predictability, quality indicators).
  • Build and maintain strong communication channels across business and technical teams to ensure transparency and alignment.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and propose practical, data-driven improvements.
  • Support change management, user enablement and post-implementation adoption activities.
  • Own end-to-end project management activities including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring/control and closure.
  • Define and manage project scope, timeline, milestones, resource plan and budget to ensure on-time and within-budget delivery.
  • Establish and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), governance cadence and escalation framework.
  • Drive cross-team/vendor coordination and dependency management across technology, operations and business units.
  • Prepare management reporting and steering committee updates on project health, delivery progress and decision points.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards, SDLC controls and audit/regulatory requirements where applicable.
  • Manage release readiness and implementation planning, including cutover, communication and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Support benefits tracking and realization against approved business case/objectives.

Requirements

  • University degree or above.
  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant working experience in technology/digital delivery, including proven experience in Scrum Master, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or hybrid delivery roles.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery framework, SDLC and project management methodologies (Agile/Waterfall/Hybrid).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience in requirement elicitation, process mapping, story writing and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Hands-on experience in project planning, dependency mapping, financial/budget tracking and resource management.
  • Experience with Agile and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Office, Power BI, MS Project).
  • High customer-centric mindset with commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to influence diverse stakeholders and drive outcomes under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance strategic and tactical priorities.
  • Experience in governance reporting, risk/issue management, and senior stakeholder/SteerCo communication.
  • Relevant certification(s) such as CSM/PSM, PMI-ACP, CBAP/CCBA, PMP/PRINCE2 would be an advantage.

Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking is a leading global financial institution that provides advisory, investment banking, financing, corporate banking and capital markets services to corporations, financial institutions, financial sponsors and sovereign and supranational organizations worldwide.

  • Native in Mandarin, Fluent in English

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Android Application Development

  • Design, build, and maintain Android applications and reusable components aligned to agreed architecture and engineering best practices.
  • Develop customer-centric user experiences using modern Android UI frameworks (Jetpack Compose and/or XML Views) and implement robust application logic using current Android development approaches.
  • Integrate applications with backend services and APIs, ensuring reliability, performance, and secure data handling.
  • Contribute directly to feature delivery, bug fixing, and technical improvements across the mobile codebase.
  • Partner with product and design to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.

Engineering Quality and Governance

  • Ensure high-quality code through clean architecture, unit testing, and peer code reviews.
  • Follow governance processes to ensure long-view technical design is in place for robustness, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Drive performance optimisation, stability improvements, and secure coding practices appropriate for banking-grade applications.
  • Maintain and improve development standards, including coding guidelines, branching strategies, release readiness checks, and technical documentation.

Issue Resolution

  • Identify and diagnose complex technical issues across devices, Android OS versions, OEM variations, and integration points.
  • Develop and implement effective solutions in a timely manner, collaborating with other engineers where needed.
  • Maintain a clear log of issues and resolutions, providing structured updates to stakeholders (including risks, mitigations, and timelines).

Continuous Improvement

  • Gather feedback from users and internal teams to identify areas for improvement in the Android app and development lifecycle.
  • Work closely with platform and engineering teams to implement enhancements and optimisations based on feedback and data (e.g., crash analytics, performance metrics).
  • Stay up to date with Android ecosystem changes (SDK updates, Jetpack libraries, Play policies, security guidance), incorporating relevant advancements into the team’s approach.
  • Contribute to documentation, including developer guides, FAQs, and troubleshooting tips to support maintainability and onboarding.

Communication and Collaboration

  • Maintain open lines of communication with product, design, QA, security, and backend teams, providing regular updates on progress and risks.
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings to share insights and collaborate on mobile-related initiatives.
  • Foster a positive, supportive environment that encourages knowledge sharing, mentoring, and teamwork.

Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving abilities, with a proven track record of resolving complex technical issues.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects and priorities.
  • Strong experience with version control (Git) and modern branching/release practices.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins (or equivalent).
  • Good understanding of Android performance optimisation (startup time, rendering, memory, battery) and secure coding best practices.
  • Experience integrating mobile apps with cloud services and APIs (REST/GraphQL), including authentication and secure session handling.
  • Working knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
  • Minimum 3+ years of professional Android development experience, including recent experience delivering production apps.Proficiency in Kotlin (and understanding of Java where required).
  • Strong understanding of Android app architecture and patterns (e.g., MVVM, Clean Architecture), modularisation, and dependency injection (e.g., Hilt/Dagger/Koin).
  • Experience building UI with Jetpack Compose (preferred) and/or Android Views, including state management and complex UI rendering.
  • Experience with Android Jetpack libraries (e.g., ViewModel, Navigation, Room/DataStore, WorkManager).
  • Solid understanding of concurrency and async programming (Coroutines/Flow, threading).
  • Experience with testing practices: unit testing (JUnit), UI testing (Espresso/Compose UI), and testability by design.
  • Awareness of security expectations for mobile banking (e.g., secure storage, encryption, certificate pinning/transport security, OWASP MASVS concepts).

Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits.   • Conduct analysis
  • Make Investment Recommendations
  • Interact with Institutional Clients
  • Arrange company visits and regular management contact for investing clients and due diligence purposes

ln:4486922428.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Head of Operations to establish and lead the entire operational framework for our new brokerage in China. This is a unique opportunity to build a world-class operations department from scratch. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep expertise in China's securities market, regulatory landscape, and operational best practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing all operational processes, systems, and teams to ensure efficiency, scalability, and full compliance with Chinese regulations.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Strategy & Setup:

  • Develop and execute the end-to-end operational strategy for the new brokerage.
  • Lead the setup of all operational infrastructure, including clearing, settlement, custody, and client services.
  • Select, implement, and integrate key operational systems and technologies (e.g., OMS, PMS, back-office systems, Rootnet)

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management:

  • Ensure all operations are fully compliant with regulations from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and other relevant authorities.
  • Establish and maintain robust internal controls, policies, and procedures (e.g., for AML/KYC, trade processing, and data privacy).
  • Develop and oversee the firm's operational risk management framework to identify, mitigate, and report risks.

Team Leadership & Development:

  • Build, train, and lead a high-performing operations team.
  • Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Set performance goals and provide ongoing coaching and development for team members.

Core Operations Management:

  • Oversee daily operations including trade capture, confirmation, clearing, and settlement for equities.
  • Manage cash management, and securities financing operations.
  • Establish and manage the client onboarding process, ensuring efficient and compliant KYC and account opening procedures.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management:

  • Act as the primary liaison with key external partners, including local exchanges (SSE, SZSE), clearing houses (CSDC, SHCH), custodian banks, and technology vendors.
  • Collaborate closely with internal departments, including Front Office, Compliance, Finance, and Technology, to ensure seamless business integration.

Financial & Performance Management:

  • Develop and manage the operations department's budget.
  • Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency and service quality.
  • Lead projects aimed at process optimization and automation.

Qualifications

  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 15+ years of experience in securities brokerage operations, with at least 7 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., Head/Director of Operations).
    • Proven track record of setting up and managing operations for a securities firm in mainland China is essential.
    • Extensive experience in a start-up or new business launch environment is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge & Skills:
    • In-depth knowledge of China's A-share market, fixed income market, and related financial products.
    • Expert understanding of the Chinese regulatory environment, including rules set by CSRC, PBOC, and SAFE.
    • Strong familiarity with local market infrastructure, including CSDC, CFETS, and major exchanges.
    • Demonstrated ability in process design, re-engineering, and implementing operational systems.
    • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Education & Language:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
    • Fluency in Mandarin Chinese is mandatory.
    • Professional proficiency in English is highly preferred.
